coachMessages.text: The Figure-7: an L-shape of 4 discs plus one key cell that creates two threats. The opponent cannot block both.

slides.infoProse: Four Yellow discs form a compact L-shape around columns 3-4. Playing in column 2 creates threats in two different directions: a horizontal 4-in-a-row at row 2, and a diagonal 4-in-a-row through the center. The opponent can only stop one.

coachMessages.text: Blocking one threat leaves the other exposed. The turn order means you always get the winning move.

slides.infoProse: If the opponent blocks one cell, you win through the other. Two threats from one setup — this is why the Figure-7 trap is so powerful.
